text:
ashley-infra: Heads up — seeing a spike in GPU provisioning failures in us-west2 this morning. Lots of nodes stuck in PROVISIONING 10-15m. Error snippets from node logs show heavy metadata fsyncs on /scratch.

node-agent: log excerpt from gnode-34:
```
[  123.456789] EXT4-fs (nvme1n1p2): journal commit failed: write sent
[  123.457012] EXT4-fs (nvme1n1p2): Metadata writeback error, IO errors
[  123.458001] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme1n1, sector 12345678
```

mike-sre: repeating pattern: small-file churn from ephemeral cleaner + batch scratch deletes causing journal commit storm and high write amplification on local SSDs. That pushes iowait up and kubelet attach times blow out.

sara-eng: interesting — saw similar in eu-west last month. Short-term we remounted with `commit=120` to reduce commit frequency and that bought time. Tradeoff is larger window for metadata loss on crash.

lee-ops: can we throttle the janitor? It currently deletes ~2000 small files/second during window which aligns with the provisioning failures.

ashley-infra: yes, remediation plan proposal:
- immediate: throttle janitor to 200 deletes/sec on us-west2 (lee will flip flag)
- immediate: staged remount of /scratch with `sudo mount -o remount,commit=120 /scratch` across warm nodes only (minimal impact)
- short-term: add node-level IOPS circuit-breaker to pause provisioning if io_util > 85%
- mid-term: change ephemeral-cleaner to randomized windows + exponential backoff on errors

mike-sre: +1. We should also increase scratchpool thresholds so kube-scheduler doesn't cram GPUs onto borderline nodes while scrubbers run.

sara-eng: long-term options to evaluate (engineering effort): xfs for scratch (lower metadata pressure for small-file churn), or introduce an inline pre-delete aggregator that coalesces deletes into fewer unlink operations.

lee-ops: doing the janitor throttle now -> `curl -XPOST https://infra-api/internal/flags/janitor_throttle -d '{"rate":200}'` :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: rolling remount job queued (us-west2 warm nodes) — job id: rmt-20260320-01

ashley-infra: runbook updates: adding a checklist for this pattern (journal bloat -> throttle janitor -> remount commit -> verify provisioning). Tagging owners: @mike-sre (followup metrics), @sara-eng (ephemeral-cleaner PR), @lee-ops (rollout)

mike-sre: I'll wire up a grafana panel for small-file unlink rate + nvme write amplification and alert if provisioning failures spike again. :eyes:

sara-eng: I'll open PR to randomize janitor windows and add a soft-rate limiter. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ashley-infra: thanks team. Monitor for 2h and escalate if provisioning rate not back to normal. :thumbsup:
